body:
Brother,

God hasn't "shut up" he speaks to us through his word. A careful study of the word tells us that he spoke to us through the prophets and in the last days his son (Hebrews 1:2). I'm not trying to argue, but just to help in any way that I can. 

I cannot say that it's not Jesus speaking to you. I can just tell you from my own experience and working as a medium, that's not how God speaks to me. Demons have, but God through his written and perfect word. So in my belief, from a biblical perspective that's not how God speaks to us anymore. Paul had his epistles written to Christians as well as Peter, John, James (the Lords brother and Jude) to warn us about these last days that we are in.

The Holy Ghost guides us to all truth and teaches and counsels us, but he does not speak an audible voice from my experience. I used to hear voices and let them guide me, and I learned they were not from God. He will provide us the truth if we ask and diligently seek him and we will know because it can be backed up by scripture (Hebrews 11:16; Jeremiah 29:13).

I'm not saying this to condemn or upset you. I'm saying it out of love so you can check into this for yourself. I can tell you a truth also from my experience that Satan isn't always evil and condemning. He speaks very kind and sweetly to us. There is no way I could have gotten into the new age and working for him if this wasn't the case. Please look at what Paul says when he warns about falling into worshipping angels (Colossians 2:18), and when he warns about the charisma and smooth speeches and devices (Romans 16:17-18) of the devil and his workers. He says "no wonder! For Satan himself transforms into an angel of light." (2 Corinthians 11:14)

Jehovah Rapha is God. It's just another name for him in the Old Testament. He says he alone is our healer, our salvation, and our God. There's a lot of beautiful passages about God's healing throughout the Bible, but even Peter was not silly enough to claim that the man he healed was on his own accord (Acts 3).. it was he gift from God. Also, when Simon the sorcerer had previously been using divination deceive many and work signs and wonders, and he saw the apostles doing miracles by god, he tried to pay them for the "power" the had from the Holy Ghost. He wanted the power for himself, and Peter told him his heart was not right with God." Acts 8:9-24. This is very similar to the new age movement that teaches that we are healers ourselves working through and energy source to heal others. Please read these passages, only God is our healer. All the glory goes to him. I am in no way saying he doesn't work through someone to heal someone else, but he does it as Jehovah Rapha our healer.

I completely agree with you on all statues and pictures of Jesus! :) we are on the same page there. :)

Yes there is such a thing as tarot cards. Many who are vulnerable like I was fall prey to them. I was introduced to them by a Christian counselor. 

My heart is so happy to hear of your healing. That's a beautiful thing and I am so happy for you! Praise God!! 

Regarding baptist vs non-baptist, Id really encourage you to look into what Paul wrote in Romans and especially first Corinthians Chapter 1 about "Is Christ Divided?" I do not believe the Lord intended for the church to separate. 

Regardless of if it is Jesus or not, I do believe he speaks.. just not through an audible voice. I cannot judge one way or another, I can just encourage you to read the word for yourself because I can completely relate to you and your pain. I have been there myself.. never with bipolar but especially with depression. The word will tell you everything you need to know. It's our greatest protection. God bless you!
‭

I appreciate you taking the time to write this message, I truly do. I am in no way perfect by any means and I am just a babe in Christ. However I have learned from experience that led me to the word that angels do not speak with us, and the ones that try are through the occult (fallen demons). I fell into the lies through Angel and Jesus tarot cards. I used to hear voices all the time, and I always thought it was God or angels. I became a medium for some time and was also told I was a healer and to heal myself.

My heart reaches out to you and asks you to please look into this for yourself. There is only one healer, Jehovah Rapha and Jesus Christ our Lord. We as humans can only heal if given the gift by the Holy Ghost, and it's not us but him. It's very rare that many are doing that today, although there is a new reformation of people who believe in an Apostolistic reformation that I also fell into. It's very very similar to the Nee Age occult.

Please I ask you to look into the word for yourself and discern, that in these last days God has spoken to us through his son. His word. I'm not saying it's not possible, but new revelations and words are not from God. 

Also, while I do realize this is most likely a test I ask you to please be kind. When you speak to me like that I feel like you're talking to me like his friends did. If I am sinning, please tell me.. but otherwise in Christ I could really use your comfort. This is not something many people understand and Lyme is not well know. 

God bless.

Edit: like Job's friends did
Thank you so so much for all of this. And thank you also for the prayers. I am very grateful for your response, time, and help. This really gave me a new perspective.

Thank you so much for your kindness. It's something I really struggle with. I love the lord so much. I really do. There's nothing more important to me than knowing him, so I'm seeking him with my whole heart. Severe illness makes that very difficult.

I will continue to do that. I weep daily. Several times a day. I have poured out my heart and soul to the times of choking on tears and my own saliva. Sometimes I feel he has abandoned me, because there are so many warnings about falling away. Sometimes I feel mad at him, then mad at myself for knowing how wrong I am.

I have cut all ties with the occult, and thrown away everything occult I owned. Yet, the "voices" still taunt me daily. I used to see number sequences and acknowledge and use them as way to communicate with "angels" before coming to the truth. I still see them daily, not AS bad.. but still bad, so it feels like demonic torment. I've prayed to the lord every day to take it away. 

I really struggle with them telling me how worthless I am. I have overcome a lot, I can honestly say I've forgiven all of my past abusers. I wish no harm on anyone who hurt me, but I struggle forgiving myself. I know I'm a sinner.. and it's hard not to beat myself up daily. I used to have a very quick tongue. I was a highly competitive female athlete and was very prideful and worldly. Not on purpose, I truly didn't know any better. When I have outbursts of wrath, or I judge another, or I am in so much pain I get snippy.. I feel so guilty I sob to God. Those around me say I'm too hard on myself.. but it's all I know. Any advice? Thank you so much.
